 WHEREAS 
 
 The Lessee is a real estate developer, and has undertaken a real estate project named and styled as ‘Zameen Ace Mall’ comprising inter alia residential apartments, hotel apartments, and commercial shops, located at Plot No. 36-A, Sector J, Jinnah Avenue/Sir Syed Boulevard, Phase II, DHA Islamabad (“ Project ”) ; 
 
 The Lessor is the sole, absolute and exclusive owner of a hotel apartment in ‘Zameen Ace Mall’ , purchased by the Lessor from the Lessee vide Agreement to Sell No. _______________ dated ________ executed by and between the Parties for sale and leaseback of the hotel apartment ; and 
 
 Pursuant to the terms and conditions of the aforementioned Agreement to Sell, the Lessor desires to lease back to the Lessee, and the Lessee desires to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Lease back Agreement . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , Lessor and Lessee, intending to be legally bound, agree as follows: 
 
 SCOPE AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 Th e Leaseback Agreement (defined below) , read along with the Agreement to Sell as well as all annexures attached thereto, and any other document(s) forming part of the Leaseback Agreement pursuant to the term and conditions hereof along with all documents enumerated in Clause 2 of the Agreement to sell , shall constitute the complete and exclusive agreement between the Parti es hereto in respect of the lease back of the Demised Premises (defined below) . 
 
 The documents specified in Clause 1 above shall be taken as mutually explanatory, and in the event of any conflict, ambiguity or discrepancy, unless otherwise specified, priority shall be given to the General Terms and Conditions attached to the Agreement to Sell , followed by Agreement to Sell , and d escription D escription of the Unit attac hed to the Agreement to Sell Demised Premises . Any terms used as defined terms and not defined in the Leaseback Agreement shall have the meaning assigned to them in the Agreement to Sell General Terms and Conditions . The rules of interpretation set out in the General Terms and Conditions shall apply to all documents forming the Lease back Agreement.

 TERM OF LEASE 
 
 The Lessor hereby agrees to irrevocably leaseback, and the Lessee hereby agrees to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises for an initial duration and lock-in period of [●] years which may be renewed in accordance with Clause 3 2 hereof (the “ Lease Period ”). The Lease Period shall commence on the Commencement Date. The Lessor hereby agrees to irrevocably leaseback , and the Lessee hereby agrees to take on lease from the Lessor, the Demised Premises for the Lease Period, which shall commenc e on the Commencement Date. 
 
 The Lease Period may be renewed upon expiry thereof for further period of ten (10) years on the same terms and conditions of the Leasebac k Agreement in accordance with c lause 28 hereof . 
 
 RENT 
 
 In consideration of the lease of the Demised Premises, the Lessee shall pay Rent and other benefits to the Lessor during the Lease Period on the following terms: 
 
 Monthly Rent shall be paid on a pro-rated basis calculated at 7% of the Purchase Price of the Demised Premises per annum . 
 
 Rent shall be increased by 25% (twenty five percent) every three years of the Lease Period. 
 
 Rent shall be paid for eleven (11) months per year of the Lease Period , along with thirty (30) C omplimentary Vouchers . The Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor in accordance with Clause 8 of the Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 COMPLIMENTARY VOUCHERS 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed or encashed by the Lessor as per the following terms : 
 
 A maximum of fifteen (15) Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed during peak season, and fifteen (15) during off-peak season , subject to availability and confirmation by the Hotel Management Company . 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers may be redeemed by the Lessor, either her/himself or for friends and family ( the “ Beneficiary ”), subject to availability. The Beneficiary shall have access to all Common F acilities and amenities of fered by the Hotel Management Company during their stay , as per the rules and regulations of the Hotel Management Company, and any additional services may be availed as per the standard schedule of rates &amp; charges set by the Hotel Management Company. 
 
 The Lessor may, at Lessor’s option, encash all thirty (30) Complimentary Vouchers in exchange for one month’s Rent. For the avoidance of doubt, one month’s Rent under this Clause 7(iii) shall only be claimed against thirty (30) unredeemed and valid Complimentary Vouchers. The Lessor may encash the Complimentary Vouchers in exchange for one month’s Rent. 
 
 Complimentary Vouchers shall be valid for a period of twelve (12) months from the date of issuance thereof and, if not redeemed or encashed during the validity stipulated period, shall not be carried forward for any further period. 
 
 OTHER CHARGES 
 
 All applicable taxes shall be borne and paid by the Parties in accordance with law. 
 
 
 PERMITTED USE 
 
 The Lessee will use , occupy , sub-lease the Demised Premises for the purpose of operating, managing and maintaining a l uxury h otel, either itself or through a Hotel Management Company, for the duration of the Lease Period. 
 
 The Lessee will comply with all applicable laws, ordinances, rules, orders, and regulations of any Competent Authority with respect to the Demised Premises and Permitted Use . 
 
 SALE AND ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Lessor shall only sell/transfer or assign the Demised Premises in accordance with the Agreement to Sell and the Rules, provided that the transferee has agreed and undertaken in writing to be bound by this Agreement and has signed a letter of adherence or such other document as may be prescribed in this regard. The Lessor shall only transfer or assign the Demised Premises with written consent of the Lessee. Such sale/transfer shall only be done on the precondition that the Lessor shall cause the transferee of the Demised Premises to be bound by the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement. 
 
 The Lessee shall have the right to sublease all or any part of the Demised Premises during the Lease Period at the Lessee’s own discretion, and the Lessor hereby undertakes to do or cause to be done all such acts, deeds and the things and execute any documents required in relation or ancillary thereto. Provided that any such sublease shall be subject to the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the Lessee’s obligation for payment of Rent hereunder. The Lessee may sell, assign, transfer, sublease or otherwise dispose of its interests in the Demised Premises during the Lease Period as the Lessee deems fit for the Permitted Use, and the Lessor hereby undertakes to do or cause to be done any acts or execute any documents required in relation or ancillary thereto. Provided that any such disposition of interest shall be subject to the terms and conditions of this Leaseback Agreement and the obligation for payment of Rent by the Lessee. 
 
 L ESSOR’S COVENANTS 
 
 The Lessor permits the Lessee to carry out any required internal partitions, modifications, or to dismantle or make alteration(s) to the Demised Premises , and install any billboards, hoardings, signage or any other promotional material as it deems fit for the Permitted Use . The Lessee shall also have the right to place and install on the Demised Premises specific outlets and adequate equipment, including inter alia equipment for central air-conditioning (if any). Lessee shall not be liable to remove, at the time of expiry or termination of the Lease back Agreement, any fixtures and fittings or to reverse alterations as made by the Lessee during the Lease Period . 
 
 The Lessor hereby represents and warrants that at the time of execution of this Leaseback Agreement , the Demised Premises is free from any lien, charge, encumbrance, etc. of whatsoever nature, and that the Demised Premises shall remain unencumbered throughout the Lease Period . The Lessor hereby represents and warrants that at the time of execution of this Leaseback Agreement , the Demised Premises is free from any lien, charge, encumbrance, etc. of whatsoever nature, and that the Demised Premises shall remain unencumbered throughout the Lease Period , and any subsequent renewed Lease Period , of this Lease back Agreement. 
 
 The Lessor shall not cause the Demised Premise s to become subject to any lien, charge or encumbrance whatsoever. 
 
 The Lessor hereby undertake s that Lessee shall enjoy quiet and peaceful possession of the Demised Premises from the date of signing of this Leaseback Agreement and during the Lease Period, without any hindrance or disturbance . 
 
 The Lessor shall not hinder in any way the Lessee’s right to manage the Demised Premises as it deems fit, including the determination by the Hotel Management Company of the schedule of rates and charges
